mentions.name: GetSize
mentions.description: This platform collects the official sizing data of the world's shoes in one place, covering 200+ brands across 70+ retailers. It serves size charts and crowdsourced fit recommendations built from the shoes users own and the sizes that fit them. AI agents autonomously build, debug and deploy crawlers (280+), access platform metrics and SEO data via custom MCPs to identify opportunities, and automatically publish new pages when new shoes are discovered; the system runs on a home server at about 3000 MAU and 100 size recommendations per day.
mentions.problem: When shoppers search for what size to get in a shoe model they find generic size charts, which are less personal and less accurate than fit-based recommendations.
mentions.audience: Shoppers looking up what size to buy for specific shoe models
